text:
The best merge conflict is the one that never happens.

Aegis OS gives agents TTL file claims + piggybacked IPC, so they reserve a file before writing—and hand off verified artifacts without polling.

https://heurion.org/en/blog/aegis-os-transactional-agent-kernel#sec-claim-ipc
notes: Anchor link to the claims/IPC section.

text:
最好的合并冲突，是根本没发生的冲突。

事前 TTL 租约文件锁 + 内嵌信箱：Agent 先认领再写入，上游产物验证完自动接力给下游，不需要轮询。

https://heurion.org/blog/aegis-os-transactional-agent-kernel#sec-claim-ipc

text:
Hot take: file locks are back.

Not 1990s lockfiles—TTL leases with agent identity, heartbeat renewal, binary-asset guards, and a hash-chained audit trail.

Prevent collisions before they become merge conflicts.

text:
98.7% of multi-agent edits merge without human intervention.

The other 1.3% hit domain gates: compilers, LaTeX, schema validators, PHI scanners.

Auto-merge is only safe when "verified" means something:

text:
98.7% 的四级 LCS 自动归并，不是靠更聪明的 LLM，而是靠结构化的 diff3 + 广义领域预检门。

代码跑测试，LaTeX 要编译，Schema 要校验，临床数据还要过 PHI 扫描。

https://heurion.org/blog/aegis-os-transactional-agent-kernel#sec-micro-commit

text:
4-tier conflict resolution:
1. identical → skip
2. fast-forward → apply
3. LCS diff3 → auto-merge
4. domain gate → human/verifier

98.7% never reaches step 4.
